correctness.rationale: Independently solved the stationarity equations z=P^T diag((1-h_+)^2,(1-h_-)^2) z + sigma^2 P^T(h_+^2,h_-^2)/2 using exact symbolic inversion. The submitted V(p)-V0 factor 2sigma^2 h^2 delta^2[2-t+2p(t-1)]/((2-h)D) and derivative dV/dp=8sigma^2 delta^2 h^4(1-delta^2)(h-1)/D^2 were both verified symbolically. D=p(1-alpha)(1-beta)+(1-p)(1-alpha beta)>0 throughout. Thus V<V0 iff t>2 and p<(t-2)/(2(t-1)); equality at t=2,p=0 or threshold for t>2; p=1/2 always loses. The periodic case p=0 requires a random stationary phase, explicitly assumed, and r<2 individual stability ensures convergence.
